newsitem.title: USA: Strong Hurricane Isidore still far from land.
newsitem.headline: Strong Hurricane Isidore still far from land.

text.p: Hurricane Isidore remained a powerful Category 3 storm on Saturday as it churned north-northwest in the distant Atlantic far from land, the National Hurricane Centre said.

At 5 a.m. EDT (0900 GMT), Isidore's centre was about 1,200 miles (1,930 km) west of the northernmost of Africa's Cape Verde Islands, at latitude 17.3 north and longitude 43.2 west, moving north-northwest near 13 mph (19 kph).

"A gradual turn to the north is expected by Saturday night," National Hurricane Centre forecasters said. That track would keep the storm from threatening the islands of the Caribbean Sea and the U.S. coast.
Maximum sustained winds were near 115 mph (185 kph) and slight weakening was possible over the next 24 hours, forecasters said.
